div.div:
Registered scanner installation, owned by one account; event permissions checked
separately.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
owner_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
device_key: text [UQ NN]
label: text [NN]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (device_key)
UQ2: (id, owner_user_id)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(owner_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Append-preserved accepted admission; current state represented by reversed_at.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
ticket_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
entry_confirmation_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
scanner_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
scanner_session_id: uuid [FK NN]
device_id: uuid [FK NN]
operation_id: uuid [NN]
source: text [NN]
accepted_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
captured_at: timestamptz [NN]
reversed_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (device_id, operation_id)
UQ2: (entry_confirmation_id)
UQ3: (id, ticket_id, event_id)
CK1: source IN ('online','offline_sync')
PARTIAL UQ: (ticket_id) WHERE reversed_at IS NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(entry_confirmation_id, ticket_id, event_id) -> entry_confirmation(id, ticket_id,
event_id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
(scanner_session_id, scanner_user_id) -> auth_session(id, user_id) [1 parent / 0..*
children]
(device_id, scanner_user_id) -> scanner_device(id, owner_user_id) [1 parent / 0..*
children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
One retained reversal for an accepted admission; never erase original row.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
check_in_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
actor_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
reason: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (check_in_id)
CK1: length(btrim(reason)) > 0
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(check_in_id) -> check_in(id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
(actor_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
